name: lookup_location_coords
description: Look up geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) for a given location name using the Open-Meteo Geocoding API. Useful before calling weather endpoints for a non-default location.

name.description: The place name to look up (e.g. 'Chicago', 'New York', 'London').

count.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 5.

execution.code: const args = JSON.parse(data); const name = encodeURIComponent(args.name); const count = args.count || 5; const url = `https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?name=${name}&count=${count}&language=en&format=json`; const res = await fetch(url); const json = await res.json(); return JSON.stringify(json, null, 2);
